svg.title: Every pattern, and what it rests on
svg.desc: A graph of the twenty-four patterns. One sealed box at the top, Property Not Policy, rests on nothing. Five patterns descend from it — the tenant is a database, a type declares what it is, work is the reason, engine and faces, and the person is a key — and every remaining pattern descends in turn from those, so no pattern in the figure stands on its own. Reading upwards from any box gives the things that must already be true before that pattern can be.
